SELECT /* LGVPAY00001.retrieveEmployeeData */ a.employee_No AS employee_no , b.full_name_local AS employee_name , a.grade_title_code AS grade_title_code , a.grade_name AS grade_title_name , a.organization_name , a.employment_category_name AS emp_category_name /*, a.job_family_name||'.' ||a.job_group_name||'.' ||a.job_series_name AS work_type_name*/ /*, DECODE(a.employment_category_code, 'LGD_OW', NULL, a.job_group_name) AS work_type_name*/ , lgvhr_common_pkg.get_shift_type_code_func(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode},a.employee_no, nvl(to_date(a.resignation_yyyymmdd,'yyyymmdd'), c.basis_date)) AS work_type_name , to_char(to_Date(a.hire_yyyymmdd,'yyyymmdd'),'dd/mm/yyyy') AS hire_date , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_pay_emp_family_n pef WHERE pef.employee_no = a.employee_no AND pef.dependent_flag = 'Y') AS dependant_count , (SELECT TO_CHAR(SUM(RESULT_VALUE), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') FROM tb_pay_calc_result_n rs WHERE rs.PAYROLL_ITEM_ID = '57' and rs.employee_no = a.employee_no and rs.PAYROLL_CALCULATION_EXEC_ID IN (select P.PAYROLL_CALCULATION_EXEC_ID from tb_pay_calc_exec_n P where P.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y' and P.BASIS_DATE = c.BASIS_DATE) and rs.RESULT_VALUE > 0) AS other_income_kind ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('IF_CONTRACT_TYPE',pec.contract_type_code, NULL, #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) FROM tb_pay_emp_contract_n pec WHERE ( employee_no, contract_period_start_date ) IN ( SELECT employee_no, MAX(a.contract_period_start_date) FROM tb_pay_emp_contract_n a WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo} GROUP BY employee_no )) contract_type_name
FROM tb_pay_result_s a , emp_master b , tb_pay_calc_exec_n c WHERE a.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND a.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND b.employee_number = a.employee_no AND c.payroll_calculation_exec_id = a.payroll_calculation_exec_id

SELECT /* LGVPAY00001.retrieveSalaryDetailData */
TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'NT' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0), 'FM9990.0') AS night_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'OT' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0), 'FM9990.0') AS ot_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'OTNT' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0), 'FM9990.0') AS otnt_hours
, TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'ATT_DED' AND NVL(ccc.common_code, 'x') = 'LATENESS' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0), 'FM9990.0') AS lateness_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'ATT_DED' AND NVL(ccc.common_code, 'x') = 'LEAVING_EARLY' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0), 'FM9990.0') AS leaving_early_hours , TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'ATT_DED' AND NVL(ccc.common_code, 'x') = 'GOOUT' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0), 'FM9990.0') AS goout_hours
, TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.helpcall_support_hours, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS helpcall_support_hours /* special ot */
, TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.working_days, 0), 'FM9990') AS act_working_days , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.absence_days, 0), 'FM9990') AS absence_leave_days , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.paid_vacation_days, 0), 'FM9990') AS paid_leave_days , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.unpaid_vacation_days, 0), 'FM9990') AS unpaid_leave_days , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.unpaid_absence_leave_days, 0) + NVL(prs.paid_absence_leave_days, 0), 'FM9990') AS suspension_leave_days
, TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') = 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.code_data1_value, 'x') = 'INCOME' AND NVL(ccc1.code_data2_value, 'x') = 'TIME_N' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS income_time_n_amount , TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') = 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.code_data1_value, 'x') = 'INCOME' AND NVL(ccc1.code_data2_value, 'x') = 'TIME_Y' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS income_time_y_amount , TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') = 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.code_data1_value, 'x') = 'DEDUCTION' THEN /* deduction의 attendance 만 abs처리 하고 그외는 원래 값으로 계산 함 */ CASE WHEN NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'ATT_DED' THEN ABS(to_number(pcr.result_value)) ELSE to_number(pcr.result_value) END ELSE 0 END), 0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS deduction_amount /* deduction의 attendance항목 금액이 (-)이므로 abs처리 함 */
, prs.bank_name AS bank_name , prs.payment_bank_account_no AS bank_account_no , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.salary_total_amount , 0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS salary_total_amount /* gross salary */ , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.deduction_total_amount, 0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS deduction_total_amount /* deduction */ , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.bank_transfer_amount , 0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS bank_transfer_amount /* net salary */
FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce , tb_pay_calc_result_n pcr , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi , tb_pay_item_detail_n pid , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi2 , lgcom_common_code_c ccc , lgcom_common_code_c ccc1 , tb_pay_result_s prs WHERE pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND ppi.payroll_item_id = pcr.payroll_item_id AND pid.payroll_item_id = ppi.payroll_item_id AND pcr.payroll_item_detail_detail_id = pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id AND ppi2.payroll_item_id = NVL(ppi.parent_payroll_item_id, ppi.payroll_item_id) AND pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pcr.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_2ND_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc.common_code = ppi.payroll_item_inq_class_code AND ccc1.code_type_code = ccc.parent_code_type_code --'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_1ST_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc1.common_code = ccc.parent_common_code AND prs.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND prs.employee_no = pcr.employee_no
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.helpcall_support_hours, 0), 'FM9990.0') , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.working_days, 0), 'FM9990') , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.absence_days, 0), 'FM9990') , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.paid_vacation_days, 0), 'FM9990') , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.unpaid_vacation_days, 0), 'FM9990') , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.unpaid_absence_leave_days, 0) + NVL(prs.paid_absence_leave_days, 0), 'FM9990')
, prs.bank_name , prs.payment_bank_account_no , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.salary_total_amount , 0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.deduction_total_amount, 0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') , TO_CHAR(NVL(prs.bank_transfer_amount , 0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990')

SELECT /* LGVPAY00001.retrieveSalaryDetailList */ cccm1.common_code_name AS code_name1 /*1차분류*/ , cccm.common_code_name AS code_name2 /*2차분류*/
, TO_CHAR(SUM(CASE WHEN pid.additional_input_value = 'PAY_VALUE' THEN /* deduction의 attendance 만 abs 처리하고, 그외는 그냥 보여줌 */ CASE WHEN ccc1.code_data1_value = 'DEDUCTION' AND ccc1.common_code = 'ATT_DED' THEN ABS(NVL(to_number(pcr.result_value), 0)) ELSE NVL(to_number(pcr.result_value), 0) END END), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS item_amount /* 금액 */ , TO_CHAR(SUM(CASE WHEN pid.additional_input_value = 'PAY_VALUE' THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN ccc1.code_data2_value = 'TIME_N' THEN NULL /* Non Working인 경우 DEDUCTION_DAYS만 가져오기 위한 조건 */ WHEN ccc1.code_data2_value = 'TIME_Y' AND ccc1.common_code = 'ATT_DED' AND ccc.common_code = 'NON_WORKING' THEN DECODE( pid.additional_input_value, 'DEDUCTION_DAYS', pcr.result_value) ELSE pcr.result_value END END), DECODE(ccc.code_data1_value, 'D', 'FM9990', 'FM9990.0')) AS item_hours /* 시간/기타정보. TIME_Y인 경우만 값 조회되도록 함. */
, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY ccc1.common_code ORDER BY ccc1.sort_order_no, DECODE( #{incomeDeductionCode}||'_'||#{incomeDeductionTimeCode}, 'INCOME_TIME_Y', 1, SIGN(ABS(SUM(decode(pid.additional_input_value, 'PAY_VALUE', NVL(pcr.result_value, 0))))) ) DESC, ccc.sort_order_no) AS rank1 /* 2차분류 순서 */ , COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY ccc1.common_code) AS rowspan_cnt1 /* 1차분류 병합 행수 */ , ccc1.code_data2_value AS time_display_code /* 시간 보여줄지 여부. TIME_Y:보여줌, TIME_N:안보여줌 */ , ccc.code_data1_value AS day_hour_code /* 일자(D), 시간(H) 구분코드 */ , ccc1.common_code AS code1 /*1차분류코드*/ , ccc.common_code AS code2 /*2차분류코드*/ FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce , tb_pay_calc_result_n pcr , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi , tb_pay_item_detail_n pid , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi2 , lgcom_common_code_c ccc , lgcom_common_code_c ccc1 , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm1 , tb_pay_result_s prs /* pay result 있는 경우만 데이터 조회되도록 join 추가 */ WHERE pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND ppi.payroll_item_id = pcr.payroll_item_id AND pid.payroll_item_id = ppi.payroll_item_id AND pcr.payroll_item_detail_detail_id = pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id AND ppi2.payroll_item_id = NVL(ppi.parent_payroll_item_id, ppi.payroll_item_id) AND pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pcr.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_2ND_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc.common_code = ppi.payroll_item_inq_class_code AND ccc1.code_type_code = ccc.parent_code_type_code --'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_1ST_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc1.common_code = ccc.parent_common_code AND cccm1.code_type_code = ccc1.code_type_code AND cccm1.common_code = ccc1.common_code AND cccm.code_type_code = ccc.code_type_code AND cccm.common_code = ccc.common_code AND cccm1.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND ccc1.code_data1_value = #{incomeDeductionCode} /* INCOME, DEDUCTION 구분 */
AND ccc1.code_data2_value = #{incomeDeductionTimeCode} /* TIME_N, TIME_Y 구분 */
AND prs.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND prs.employee_no = pcr.employee_no
GROUP BY cccm1.common_code_name , cccm.common_code_name , ccc.sort_order_no , ccc1.sort_order_no , ccc1.common_code , ccc1.code_data2_value , ccc.code_data1_value , ccc1.common_code , ccc.common_code
ORDER BY ccc1.sort_order_no , DECODE( #{incomeDeductionCode}||'_'||#{incomeDeductionTimeCode}, 'INCOME_TIME_Y', 1, SIGN(ABS(SUM(decode(pid.additional_input_value, 'PAY_VALUE', NVL(pcr.result_value, 0))))) ) DESC /* 금액이 있는 건을 우선 보여준다. 단, OT는 항목순서대로 */ , ccc.sort_order_no

SELECT /* LGVPAY00001.retrieveAdjustmentList */ ppi.payroll_item_name AS element_code , ppi.inquiry_name AS element_name , TO_CHAR(SUM(decode(pid.additional_input_value, 'PAY_VALUE', NVL(pcr.result_value, 0))), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS element_amount FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce , tb_pay_calc_result_n pcr , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi , tb_pay_item_detail_n pid , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi2 , lgcom_common_code_c ccc WHERE pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND ppi.payroll_item_id = pcr.payroll_item_id AND pid.payroll_item_id = ppi.payroll_item_id AND pcr.payroll_item_detail_detail_id = pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id AND ppi2.payroll_item_id = NVL(ppi.parent_payroll_item_id, ppi.payroll_item_id) AND pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pcr.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_2ND_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc.common_code = ppi.payroll_item_inq_class_code AND ccc.common_code = 'ADJ_INCOME'
GROUP BY ppi.payroll_item_name, ppi.inquiry_name

SELECT /* LGVPAY00001.retrieveCalculationDetailList */ ppi.inquiry_name , TO_CHAR(pdc.basis_start_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS base_start_date , TO_CHAR(pdc.basis_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS base_end_date , TO_CHAR(pdc.payment_base_amount, 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS payment_base_amount , pdc.working_days FROM tb_pay_detail_calc_t pdc , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi WHERE pdc.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pdc.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND ppi.payroll_item_id = pdc.payroll_item_id

SELECT /* LGVPAY00001.retrieveContributionPitList */ cccm.common_code_name AS element_name , TO_CHAR(a.result_value, 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS element_amount , b.payroll_item_inq_class_code FROM tb_pay_calc_result_n a , tb_pay_payroll_item_m b , tb_pay_item_detail_n c , lgcom_common_code_c ccc , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm WHERE a.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND a.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND b.payroll_item_id = a.payroll_item_id AND c.payroll_item_detail_detail_id = a.payroll_item_detail_detail_id AND c.additional_input_value = 'PAY_VALUE' AND B.PAY_ITEM_CLASSIFICATION_CODE = 'ER_CHARGES' AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_2ND_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc.common_code = b.payroll_item_inq_class_code AND cccm.code_type_code = ccc.code_type_code AND cccm.common_code = ccc.common_code AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} ORDER BY ccc.sort_order_no

SELECT /* LGVPAY00001.retrieveRetroPayDetailList */ t.payroll_calculation_exec_id ,t.employee_no ,t.retroactive_pay_target_yyyymm ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t.retroactive_pay_target_yyyymm,'yyyymm'),'MM/YYYY') AS retroactive_target_month ,t.payroll_item_id ,b.payroll_item_name ,b.detail_desc AS pay_item_description ,t.retroact_act_pay_diff_amount AS different_amt FROM tb_retro_actual_pay_diff_n t ,tb_pay_payroll_item_m b WHERE t.payroll_item_id = b.payroll_item_id AND t.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND t.payroll_calculation_exec_id IN (select a.payroll_calculation_exec_id from tb_pay_calc_exec_n a ,tb_pay_calc_exec_n c where c.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} and c.basis_date = a.basis_date and a.payroll_type_code IN ('MTH', 'MTH_RS') and a.retroactive_flag = 'Y') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t.retroactive_pay_target_yyyymm,'yyyymm'),'MM/YYYY'), b.detail_desc

SELECT /* LGVPAY00001.retrieveOtherIncomeInputList */ TO_CHAR(peo.payment, 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS payment , peo.remark AS remark , peo.ap_number AS ap_number , peo.pic_id AS pic_id , peo.pic_name AS pic_name FROM tb_pay_emp_other_income_n peo, tb_pay_result_s prs WHERE peo.employee_no = prs.employee_no AND peo.payment_yyyymm = prs.basis_yyyymm AND prs.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND prs.payroll_type_code = 'MTH' AND prs.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
